headlines.title: Supermarkets across Europe report new suspected freezer hack
headlines.summary: The incidents raise concerns of a repeat of the disruption that took place in France last month, when 700 stores were hit by cyberattacks that disabled refrigeration systems and forced shops to throw out damaged food.

headlines.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
headlines.summary: Mark Zuckerberg's Meta made AI look so stinking cute by giving it a squishy little face - and this holiday season, he wants to sell you a Muse Charm so you can carry your jolly AI helper around like a Tamagotchi. But I won't be buying one, because we have Muse Charm at home.

concept.title: Tokens & Context Windows
concept.body: Models read and bill in 'tokens' (word fragments), and a 'context window' caps how much they consider at once. Bigger context lets you feed more, but cost and latency rise with it.
concept.takeaway: Watch cost-per-task, not just cost-per-token — verbose prompts add up fast.
